title: BenchmarkPhysicalMetricRecord
description: Schema for real physical benchmark measurement and performance gate assertion

payloadBytes.description: Uncompressed input payload size in bytes

isZeroCopyUsed.description: Whether APFS zero-copy was used (must be strictly false in benchmark)

isPassed.description: Whether the measurement satisfied the gate floor

gateFloorMBs.description: Minimum required throughput floor in MB/s
